items.claim: Ian Garry's stabbing kicks are very dangerous and effective due to his reach and bad intentions.
items.quote: his stabbing kicks are very very dangerous... it's his reach and how much bad intention he puts on them

items.claim: Ian Garry has good takedown defense against body-lock wrestling attempts.
items.quote: His takedown defense is good if you wrestle him on the body.

items.claim: Shavkat Rakhmonov tried to wrestle Ian Garry on the body for two rounds and could not get him down.
items.quote: Shavkat wrestled him I remember for two rounds on the body he couldn't get him down.
